visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman in her late 20s or early 30s standing in a modern, bright kitchen. She wears a black and white horizontal striped t-shirt and has her hair tied back. She is holding a large cardboard box for a 'Lustroware Slide Pitcher' and speaking directly to the camera with expressive facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) The scene transitions to various close-up shots of the product packaging and the pitcher itself. Text and diagrams on the box show technical details such as temperature resistance. The woman's hands are seen unboxing and handling the clear plastic pitcher which has a white lid. (3) The woman is then shown at a stainless steel kitchen sink, washing the pitcher and its white plastic lid with a yellow sponge under running water. The lighting is bright and even. (4) Next, she places a blue and white bag of Japanese barley tea next to the sink. She puts two tea bags into one of the pitchers and fills it with water from the kitchen faucet. (5) Two pitchers, now filled with water and tea bags, are placed on a white kitchen counter. The background shows a clean, organized kitchen with appliances like an electric kettle. (6) In the final phase, the woman demonstrates the pitcher's leak-proof feature by placing it horizontally on a shelf inside a refrigerator. She shows the 'one-touch' opening mechanism on the lid and concludes by speaking to the camera, recommending the product.

A female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a friendly and enthusiastic tone, explaining that the original audio was lost and this is a post-recorded voiceover. (2) As she describes the product features, the music continues at a consistent volume. Occasional 'pop' sound effects emphasize key points. (3) During the cleaning sequence, the sound of running water and the faint clinking of the pitcher against the sink are audible beneath the voiceover and BGM. (4) When she fills the pitcher, a distinct water splashing/pouring sound is heard. The narrator's speech rate remains steady and clear. (5) In the final segment, the voiceover continues to describe the leak-proof test. A subtle 'ding' sound effect is used to signal a successful result when showing the pitcher horizontally in the fridge. The BGM fades out at the very end.
